post.x-allowed-actors: Verified Lab Staff: active matching laboratory membership

post.description: Allowed actor: Patient: own record or Verified Lab Staff: active matching laboratory membership. Patient uploads own document without lab attribution. Lab requires active upload_request_id matching patient/lab/document; consumes request atomically, deduplicates lab reference and notifies patient. Manual lab reports must first be uploaded with stage_for_report=true. The document must be active, owned by this patient, uploaded by the caller, and bound to this upload request. Publication, request consumption, notification, audit and idempotency success are atomic. Same-key/same-body retries replay the original 201 even after request consumption; changed body with that key returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Another publication with an expired/revoked/used request or already-published document returns 409 INVALID_STATE. A missing or mismatched document returns 404 NOT_FOUND. A failed publication preserves the staged document and does not commit publication changes. Patient-source publication has no lab notification.

Lab requires active matching upload request, or supersedes_id from authorized lab correction. PDFs/JPEG/PNG <=10 MiB; file bytes validated. Lab cannot upload arbitrary patient files. ML-116: stage_for_report defaults to false. For an initial laboratory upload, false publishes immediately, consumes the request and notifies the patient; do not publish again. True stores a staged document bound to upload_request_id without consuming the request or notifying the patient. Publish that document using the reports endpoint with the same request and a lab_reference. Patient self-uploads must use false and publish without laboratory fields. Corrections cannot be staged.

post.description: The patient may correct their own active patient-entered measurement only. Lock original row; create a same-type replacement with supersedes_id and correction_reason; mark original superseded atomically, preserving lineage and audit. Concurrent distinct corrections against the same original: one succeeds, others receive 409 STALE_VERSION. Same idempotency key and body returns the original response. Blood pressure requires two positive values and mmHg; weight requires kg/lb and no secondary value; blood glucose requires mmol/L or mg/dL and no secondary value. The server derives patient, type, source, recorder and status.
